problem: Chat-side LinkedIn OAuth was healthy while the Supabase Powerhouse runtime still saw only provider-dead LinkedIn accounts.
root_cause: OAuth was repaired in a different Composio credential/workspace lineage than the production COMPOSIO_API_KEY used by Powerhouse.
fix: Add create_link and resume actions to the production LinkedIn setup controller so reconnect originates from the exact production Composio workspace and resumes the same daily claim.
prevention: OAuth repair authority belongs to the production runtime workspace.
Verify provider health in Supabase after authorization.
Resume the existing daily claim; never create a second claim or fallback writer.
